title: Capillary prisms, Coxeter gluing, and the $π_2$-systole of 3-manifolds with positive scalar curvature
summary: We study the $π_2$-systole of positive scalar curvature $3$-manifolds via a local-to-global approach. The tessellated local building blocks are capillary prisms $M$: Riemannian cylinders enclosed by mean convex surfaces meeting at prescribed dihedral angles. For a class of such prisms, called energy-essential prisms, we obtain angle-sensitive relative $π_2$-systole estimates.
